newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NEW ZEALAND RUGBY PLAYER ACCUSED OF SAFRICAN RAPE.
newsitem.headline: NEW ZEALAND RUGBY PLAYER ACCUSED OF SAFRICAN RAPE.

text.p: A New Zealand rugby player was charged with rape in a South African court on Saturday.
Roger Randle, a winger for the Wellington Hurricanes of the Super 12 professional league, was not asked to plead and was granted 5,000 rand ($1,134) bail.
"He has appeared in court and was charged with rape," police spokesman Bala Naidoo told Reuters, adding that the case has been adjourned to Monday.
He said a 31-year-old woman in the east coast port city of Durban alleged she was raped by Randle in a city hotel room in the early hours of Saturday morning.
